transcript.content: Hello, it’s nice to meet you. What brings you in today?

Nice to meet you too. Well, I’m here because... I guess I’ve gotten to the point where I plan my entire summer around avoiding wasps. It's just getting to be too much. 

I’ve even had to give up doing the garden jobs I usually do at our church. And if I hear buzzing outside, I end up making my husband unload things by the back porch instead of me going out there. I just... I really can't be anywhere near them.
Is your fear limited to wasps, or do you also fear other insects or animals?

No, it's really just wasps. I mean, I don't love spiders or anything, but they don't bother me like this. Bees are fine too, as long as they aren't swarming or something. But wasps... no. It's just them.
What do you fear would happen if you encountered a wasp?

I mean, I know a wasp is just a little insect. Most folks would just swat it away and not think twice about it. But to me... it just feels like something terrible is about to happen if one gets anywhere near me. I don't even know exactly what it is I think will happen, it's just this awful feeling that I'm in real danger.
Is your fear mainly that a wasp will sting you?

I'm honestly not sure if it's the sting. I mean, I definitely don't want to be stung, but... I don't think that's the main thing going through my head. It's really just them being there. As soon as I see one, or even hear that buzzing, I just panic. I don't even stop to think about a stinger, I just know I need to get away from it right that second.
How long have you been experiencing this intense fear of wasps?
Well, it's been going on for about two years and five months now. We were doing a remodel on the house, and... well, it uncovered a wasp nest. That's really when this whole thing started.
